claims.gist: By 2024, 40% of consumers will manipulate tracking metrics to devalue their data
By 2024, 30% of corporate teams will operate without a boss
Decouple management from the manager role to gain agility in hybrid work
By 2025, synthetic data will avoid 70% of privacy violation sanctions
By 2024, a cyberattack will prompt a G20 member to respond with physical attack
By 2024, 80% of CIOs will cite modular redesign as a top-five performance driver

thesis: Predictions to 2024-2025: consumers sabotage data, teams go bossless, synthetic data curbs privacy sanctions, cyberattacks provoke retaliation.
